text:
Maya Chen: morning handoff — I'm primary until 12:30 UTC. Liam needs to leave at 11:50 — switching secondary to Rachel for ~40 mins. :wave:
Liam O'Neill: super sorry, double-booked IRL. Leaving at 11:50 but reachable via phone for emergencies. I'll finish the on-call checklist before I go.
Maya Chen: noted. Adam K., can you cover pager 2 (latency/5xx incidents) for 11:50-12:30? We need someone to own the mit_prevent_kv_cache_bloat runbook if it fires.
Adam K.: yes I can take pager 2 during that window. Please add me to PD for that timeslot.
Oncall Bot: Incident alert (INC-20256) - 11:22 UTC - elevated 5xx rate on inference-host-pool-a. Seeding channel #incidents and paging primary.
Maya Chen: seeing the bot — I'm triaging INC-20256 now. Initial checks: `tail` of worker logs show OOM spikes on worker-03 and qcache pressure. Running: `kubectl logs -n inference worker-03 | tail -n 100`.
Liam O'Neill: if OOM, try temp scaling: `kubectl scale deployment inference-worker --replicas=6 -n inference` and bump nodepool autoscaler. Also consider toggling `enable_prefix_cache` to false for a few mins if cache thrash is suspected.
Rachel: FYI customer-impact tag shows a small subset of requests 502/503, rate ~0.8% — flagging as partial customer impact. We should prep a CS note if this crosses 1% sustained.
Maya Chen: action items: (1) Adam covers pager 2 11:50-12:30; (2) I'll continue triage until handoff; (3) Rachel, please draft a short customer update template if we hit >1% or SLA risk.
Rachel: on it — drafting now, will ping for quick review. Suggest simple wording + ETA estimate and mitigation steps.
Adam K.: scaled workers to 6, watching metrics. Added `oom-kill` filter to the dashboard and set a temporary alert threshold (3 kills / 5m) to speed detection.
Oncall Bot: Reminder — paging rules: if primary doesn't ack within 2m -> page secondary; if incident escalates to Sev2 (customer impact >1% or SLA breach) -> page ENG-SRE and SRE Lead. See runbook: https://confluence.redwood/runbooks/oncall/escalation
Maya Chen: during short coverage gaps: primary posts handoff thread, secondary pins ownership, and SRE Lead paged only if mitigation hasn't stabilized after 15m. Document any config changes and who executed them in the thread for postmortem.
Liam O'Neill: checklist verification done; leaving now. Thanks, team. :wave:
Maya Chen: thanks — Adam, confirm you'll own the pager and escalate per the bot rules if needed.
Adam K.: confirmed. I'll escalate to SRE Lead if we see sustained >1% errors or p95 latency >2s for 10m.
Maya Chen: great. I'll post a short stabilization update once the error rate drops below 0.3% for 5m. Keep all logs/commands inline in this thread so we have a clear timeline for the postmortem.
